meta.source: Nathan 2026-10-14: stop adding systems — make one complete neuron-transmitter cycle real. The milestone everything else grows around.

executable_neural_cycle.law: No new systems until one complete neuron-transmitter cycle is REAL. Every other feature grows around this foundation.
executable_neural_cycle.milestone: Send ONE transmitter through the mesh: show its route and resonance calculation, update ONE planet's activation, record a REPLAYABLE event.

executable_ontology.planet: owns neuron state: activation, threshold, recovery, receptors
executable_ontology.agent: carries transmitter signal: source, destination, type, strength, frequency, arrival time
executable_ontology.signal: travels along a network edge; the receiving planet's state CHANGES
executable_ontology.inspection: the whole causal chain is inspectable: release -> route -> per-hop gain -> binding -> state delta -> reuptake

resonance_delivery.rule: a signal is DELIVERED only when its gain clears a defined threshold; below threshold it attenuates or fails — visibly
resonance_delivery.connectivity: COMPUTED from the graded links (reachability via BFS over threshold-clearing edges), never declared. hubIndependent is a measured property, not a flag.
resonance_delivery.known_case: 555 Hz world isolated and 547 Hz peer group under exact-match linking — fixed by graded gain + multi-hop routing, verified by the reachability test

automated_tests: activations stay bounded under the neuron update
signal strength decays as specified along the route
every claimed-connected node is reachable (BFS over live links)
a failed transmitter (below-threshold gain) behaves as specified — visible failure, no silent drop
resource totals balance across harvest, transit, fusion, and construction

mechanics_claims_gaps.dissolveLanguage: must USE the returned primitives to build the new language — no unused return values
mechanics_claims_gaps.project_indexer: discovers files (wired to files/project-ingest-manifest.json or live discovery) — no embedded fake batches
mechanics_claims_gaps.rotation_sweep: checks RENDERED frames (real readback) or is honestly relabeled as a geometric check — no description claiming what the code doesn't do
mechanics_claims_gaps.mira: keyword rules are presentation, not cognition — labeled honestly

runtime_boundary.law: The browser is visualization, state inspection, and approval — NOT cognition.
runtime_boundary.real_agents: live agent reasoning and tool use go through a controlled runtime; until that runtime exists, template behavior is labeled as template behavior
runtime_boundary.persistence: world state + signal/event history persist; runs are replayable from the event log

refactor.separation: simulation model, renderer, and UI are separate layers
refactor.language_index: the accessible element/project index is the non-3D control surface
refactor.placement_honesty: the 20D readout (Q^T R x) drives actual placement — or the readout is fixed to match what places the nodes
